# nobus_lbaas_listener (Resource)

A listener on a Nobus LBaaS load balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_lbaas_listener" "https" {
  name             = "https"
  load_balancer_id = nobus_lbaas_load_balancer.example.id
  protocol         = "HTTPS"
  protocol_port    = 443
  allow_from       = "0.0.0.0/0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `allow_from` (String)
- `load_balancer_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `protocol` (String)
- `protocol_port` (Number)
